title: The Motherland
description: The not-so-ultimate 1970-ish soviet experience. I AM NOT PROMOTING COMMUNISM!!!!!!!!!!!
body:
Bring the spirit of the USSR to your Minecraft 1.21.8 world!

This NeoForge mod adds a touch of Soviet history and culture to your game. From iconic gear to classic music, it’s got everything you need to build your own comrade-friendly base.

What’s Inside?

**Classic Gear**: Craft the legendary **AK-47** to defend your village.

**Food & Drink**: Take a break with a bottle of **Vodka**. _(NOT PROMOTING ALCHOHOL!!!!!)_

**The Comrades**: New NPCs that bring life to your world.

**Atmosphere**: Listen to iconic **Soviet music** on custom discs.

New Dimension: A joke dimension (made using blocks of motherland and light it with a special lighter)
